# Gertie Pye & Jane Andrews

- [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) — Comrade of — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — canvassing committee members for the Improvement Society · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P71](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as they drive through the countryside to canvass for hall repairs. They visit several local residents, dealing with the pessimistic Miss [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md), receiving a secret donation from Catherine, helping Dan Blair mix a cake, and navigating Mrs. Theodore White's extreme cleanliness to gather subscriptions.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) residents, visiting Mrs. Theodore White and several other neighbors with varying degrees of success. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) has just had a son, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cleverly visits him while he is overjoyed and secures a five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P50](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0050), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

> Mrs. Lynde tells [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about preparations for the Ladies' [Aid](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar and asks to borrow Miss Barry's platter, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns Marilla's sight is improving. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) receives a letter from the twins' uncle extending their stay, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) remembers a conversation with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) announces that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted ads, prompting a committee of girls to try unsuccessfully to talk him out of it.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted
